why: ACAI — the people, places, groups, deities and things the Bible names — read by `type: acai`.
`dataset` is the id the data is registered under on a machine, with `sp dataset add`. The
catalog does not describe it: the catalog is vendored, and an item it provides is a text.
`resources` are the texts ACAI was made about. Its README aligns it to the word segmentation of
Macula Hebrew and the text of the SBL Greek New Testament, so it is an analysis of SBLGNT and
WLC and of no other text. Asked against another resource, the step answers `null`.
`versification` is the scheme ACAI's own references are in.
